acq_time.Description: Start of acquisition, local time of the acquisition computer. The source carries no timezone.

source_session.Description: Name of the session folder in the lab's deposit.

male_id.Description: Animal ID of the male of the pair.

female_id.Description: Animal ID of the female of the pair.

male_track_name.Description: The male's track name in the 3D file, <animal ID>_<number of tail marks>.

female_track_name.Description: The female's track name in the 3D file, <animal ID>_<number of tail marks>.

experimental_code.Description: The lab's code for the session, verbatim. Its meaning is not documented.

frame_rate.Description: Recording frame rate stored in the 3D file, in Hz.

pose3d_frame_count.Description: Frames in the 3D file. It can be a few frames shorter than the videos.

calibration.Description: Name of the calibration file the session uses.

notes.Description: Known issues with the session, from the lab README and dataset card.
